_comment: Curated facts for Samuelsignals OS — the numbers that live in prose in the
domain files and cannot be parsed out of a markdown table.
EVERYTHING ELSE IS PARSED, NOT TYPED: the daily rows come from ledger.md, the
money rows from money-ledger.md, the habits from habits.md, the budget lines
from tools/sheets/plan.json, the failure modes from patterns.md.
Keep this file small. If a number can be derived, derive it in build.py.
A number typed in two places is a number that will disagree with itself.

pots.note: Bank is everything he can spend today. Cowrywise is RING-FENCED and locked to Jan 2027 — it never counts toward the goals.

goals.name: ₦1,000,000 saved and still there
goals.note: NO ACCOUNT YET — ₦146,041 moves on 14 Sep and has nowhere to go. It cannot share the Buffer's account: the Buffer is designed to be spent and the ₦1M is not. Budgeted PER MONTH from 2026-08-28, not as a flat average: Sep ₦146,041 (its ₦140,000 of one-offs come first), then ₦286,041 × 3. The money that moves him into the new house. Separate from the ₦500,000/month construction payment, which is an expense, not savings. At the August mix Sep–Dec produce ~₦1,204,164, closing at ~₦1,007,667 after ₦200,000 goes to the Buffer — a margin of ₦7,667. One ₦200,000 raid of exactly August's kind ends it.

goals.name: ₦4,000,000 total by the wedding
goals.note: The ₦3M is ON TOP of the ₦1M. CORRECTED 2026-08-28: the old ₦152,000–₦186,000/month shortfall was wrong twice over — it used the pre-26-Aug surplus figure, and it subtracted Cowrywise from a period in which Cowrywise has already stopped. From January, income ₦1,387,741 minus bills ₦951,700 leaves ₦436,041 free. Goal 2 needs ₦428,571, so it clears by ₦7,470 — a 1.7% margin — and the ₦50,000 emergency fund on top does not fit, leaving ₦42,530/month to find. NOT impossible. Knife-edge, and only while the August mix holds for seven straight months. July was 2 videos, which does not cover the bills.

goals.name: Emergency fund
goals.note: Funded from January 2027, AFTER the ₦1M closes. His call: it does not compete with the December target.

goals.name: Cowrywise investment (ring-fenced)
goals.note: Rule 7. ₦100,000/month to year end. NEVER counts toward the ₦1M or the ₦3M and is never spent on them. Moves into actual stocks January 2027. Said once: he is funding a locked pot he refuses to count, while holding ₦2,503 liquid. A deliberate trade — long-term wealth bought with short-term fragility.

goals.name: Buffer
goals.note: LIVES IN THE SAVINGS ACCOUNT ALREADY CALLED ‘Emergency’ — his answer 2026-08-28. NAME CLASH: that account holds the BUFFER Sep–Dec, not the emergency fund, which does not start until Jan 2027. From January two pots would share one account and the balance stops meaning anything. ₦50,000/month, plus month-end underspend, plus the whole excess of any 4-video month. THE IN-MONTH CUSHION URGENCIES COME OUT OF, so savings stop being the valve. Not a goal pot: it gets spent, on purpose. Margin has never stopped a raid. A buffer does.

goals.name: Module 1 recorded
goals.note: Module 1 is lessons 1–13; 2 recorded, 11 remaining. Two lessons a week in the Sunday 5:00–7:30pm block. Module 1 completes Sun 11 Oct; beta launches Fri 16 Oct with 5 days of buffer. IF THE 11 OCT LIVE EDIT SLIPS, THE LAUNCH SLIPS.

goals.note: THE SCORED VERSION of the 5,000-follower ambition. 460 → 5,000 in four months is ~11x and fails the R in SMART. The goal that gets scored is the input he controls: one video, Wednesday 7:00pm WAT, no miss. Missing the TIME counts as missing the week.

income.split: 70% at month end, 30% mid the following month. The mid-month payment is always last month's remainder, never a new batch.
